title: What Is ElevenLabs? Creative, Agents and API Explained
desc:
ElevenLabs is AI voice infrastructure: text to speech, speech to text, voice cloning, conversational agents and generative audio. In episode one of the ElevenLabs Masterclass you will see the three product areas the docs describe, ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI, the core ideas of voices, models and credits, and the full map of this 33-episode course.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
